name: ANSI/IEEE current transformer with conductor indication symbol
summary: IEEE-library CT form that shows the primary conductor passing through the core, as with window and bar-type CTs.
description: This CT form draws the primary conductor explicitly passing through the transformer core. It suits window, bar and bushing CTs where the primary is the main circuit conductor itself, and it helps the reader see which conductor, and how many passes, the CT encloses.

The conductor indication does not give ratio, accuracy class or burden. If the primary passes the window more than once, the effective ratio changes, so turns through the window must be noted beside the symbol.
readingNotes: Count primary passes through the window.
Check polarity marks against the primary current direction.
distinction: The conductor-indication form shows the enclosed primary; the plain CT form represents the CT without showing how the primary is arranged.
